ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a transition-state structure with atom labels N, O, OH, R1, R2, R3, and H, plus curved arrows that are to be ignored. The non-hydrogen framework contains an N=C connection to a carbon bearing R1 and O; that O connects to a central carbon; the central carbon connects to an upper carbon, to R3, and to the O of an OH group; the upper carbon connects to N and R2. Reasoning: Following the required listing and excluding bonds involving hydrogen, the non-hydrogen bonds are: N=C, C-R1, C-O, O-C(central), C(central)-C(upper), C(upper)-N, C(upper)-R2, C(central)-R3, and C(central)-O of the OH group. Counting these listed bonds gives 9.

method.method_draft: Count non-hydrogen incident connections for each node: N has 2 non-H connections (to imine carbon and upper carbon); imine carbon has 3 (to N, R1, O); ring O has 2 (to imine carbon and central carbon); upper carbon has 3 non-H connections (to N, central carbon, R2); central carbon has 4 non-H connections (to upper carbon, ring O, R3, OH oxygen); OH oxygen has 1 non-H connection (to central carbon); R1, R2, and R3 each have 1. The incidence total is 18, and each bond was counted at both ends, so 18/2 = 9 bonds.

推理：按非氢节点的入射连接数计数：N 有 2 个非氢连接；亚胺碳有 3 个；环状 O 有 2 个；上方碳有 3 个；中心碳有 4 个；OH 氧有 1 个；R1、R2、R3 各有 1 个。入射连接总数为 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 18。每条键在两个端点各计一次，所以总键数为 18 / 2 = 9。
